obligations.binding: Original contact normalization and its full finite source order/chart; the existing whole-source root-sign maps.

obligations.name: Index and domain coverage
obligations.binding: All four indices and all sixteen signs; every actual field-valued global point above a finite contact. No chosen affine lift is a public final assumption.

obligations.name: Comparison maps
obligations.binding: SourceSignChart actual_square retains both full chart and actual normalization maps; SourceFinitePointLift uses the full opensRange and Spec.homEquivAlgHom.

obligations.name: Actual coefficients
obligations.binding: The root squares remain c_j*(a_i-a_j); units and distinct labelled contacts prove exact zero/nonzero cases.

obligations.name: Two-way witness
obligations.binding: fixed_iff uses all four generators and char-zero field cancellation; fixed_exactly identifies literal identity and own-root flip, not only their inclusion.

obligations.name: Counting and exceptions
obligations.binding: supportedEquiv leaves exactly one Bool; independent actual sign-map faithfulness gives two distinct Scheme maps. No existence over arbitrary F is assumed or claimed.

obligations.name: Validation
obligations.binding: All five final bounded strict checks pass; exact logs/source/object hashes retained. Combined hosted audit/replay and independent review pending.

obligations.name: Boundary
obligations.binding: Point stabilizers only; nonreduced fiber action, valuation/residue inertia, ramification index, infinity and Jacobian/PEL are separate.
